result:
Done — typecheck passes and `bun test` is green (13 tests across 3 files).

**Summary.** Posts now carry a `slug` column (`db/schema.ts`, plus migration `db/migrations/20260818072731_add_slug_to_posts/` which rebuilds the table with `slug text NOT NULL UNIQUE` and backfills existing rows as `post-<id>`; the seeder in `db/seeders/002_posts.ts` gives the sample posts real slugs). Slug generation lives in the new pure helper `app/Support/slug.ts` (`slugify`: NFKD-folded, lowercase ASCII, single `-` joins, trimmed) and `Post.uniqueSlug()` in `app/Models/Post.ts`, which appends the next free number (`hello-world-2`, `hello-world-3`) and falls back to `post` for titles with nothing sluggable; it is called only from `PostController.store()` via `forceCreate` (slug stays out of `fillable`), so editing a title never rewrites the slug. The post route is now `GET /posts/:slug` (`routes/web.ts`, regenerated `.guren/*` + `types/generated/routes.d.ts`) and `PostController.show()` validates the new `PostSlugParamSchema`, answering a purely numeric segment that matches a post id with a 301 to `/posts/<slug>` and otherwise looking the post up by slug (unknown slug or id → 404). `store` and `update` redirect to the slug URL; edit/update/destroy stay id-based. `PostResource` exposes `slug`, and the post list (`resources/js/pages/posts/Index.tsx`) and home page (`resources/js/pages/Home.tsx`) link through it. Tests added: `tests/slug.test.ts` for `slugify`, and a `posts.show` block in `tests/PostController.test.ts` covering slug creation, numbered collisions, 200 at the slug, 404s, the 301 from the old id address, and slug stability across a title change; README's route list was updated too.
